1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein the ratio of said polyalkylenimine to said polyanion is between 1:1 and 1:10.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, wherein the multivalent cation crosslinker is present in an amount sufficient to crosslink the polyelectrolyte complex.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine and has a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, wherein the polyanion is present in an amount sufficient to form a stable complex with said polyalkylenimine.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, wherein the amount of said crosslinker is effective to form a stable gel.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, wherein the concentration of said cations is sufficient to enhance the stability of the polyelectrolyte complex.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprises a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, and wherein the size is controlled by the ratio of polyalkylenimine to polyanion.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, wherein the cation is selected from the group consisting of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, and wherein the amount of cation is effective to enhance the properties of the composition.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al, wherein the concentration of said cation is sufficient to provide crosslinking within the polyelectrolyte complex.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1, wherein said composition is designed for controlled release of an oil and gas chemical; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide, wherein the polymer is present in an amount effective to enhance the viscosity of the composition. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater, and wherein the composition is stable in said fluid.
